info.headline: YELLOW ALERT: Moderate high wind impact forecast for bay of bengal east coast (Impact Severity Index 3.86/10)
info.description: YELLOW ALERT. bay of bengal east coast is forecast in the moderate-impact class. Recommended action: monitor updates, brief local bodies, and prepare shelters and relief stocks.
